wsl.permission.warning.title: Turning on WSL
wsl.permission.warning.message: Setup needs your permission once to turn on WSL.
wsl.permission.warning.fix: Run Setup again when you are ready.

wsl.update.failed.title: Updating WSL
wsl.update.failed.message: WSL could not be updated (exit code {exit_code}).
wsl.update.failed.fix: Run Setup again. If it keeps failing, choose Save diagnostics.

setup.generic.failure.title: Cognita Setup could not finish this step
setup.generic.failure.fix: Choose Save diagnostics for support information.

setup.generic.warning.title: Setup needs your attention
setup.generic.warning.fix: Review the details in Setup and choose Save diagnostics if needed.

setup.acceleration.fallback_unavailable.title: Acceleration
setup.acceleration.fallback_unavailable.message: The requested {vendor} GPU is unavailable ({reason}), so Cognita will use the CPU.
setup.acceleration.fallback_unavailable.fix: Cognita can continue using the CPU.

reasons.no_image: this release has no matching GPU image
reasons.driver_unavailable: Linux cannot see the NVIDIA driver
reasons.driver_too_old: the NVIDIA driver is older than 580
reasons.runtime_unavailable: Docker does not know the NVIDIA runtime
reasons.saved_profile: the saved GPU profile can no longer be honored

setup.acceleration.verification_failed.title: Acceleration
setup.acceleration.verification_failed.message: The {vendor} GPU could not be verified. Cognita will use the CPU.
setup.acceleration.verification_failed.fix: Cognita can continue using the CPU.
